## Qwen Edit Uncensored API

Qwen Edit Uncensored is an image editing model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `qwen-edit-uncensored`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Qwen Edit Uncensored is an uncensored image editor based on Alibaba's Qwen image editing model, with improved quality and precision. It changes a source image from a natural-language instruction, without masks.

### Qwen Edit Uncensored API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen-edit-uncensored` | Edit | Private | $0.04 / edit |

### Qwen Edit Uncensored specifications

### How to use the Qwen Edit Uncensored API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/edit` with `"model": "qwen-edit-uncensored"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/edit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen-edit-uncensored",
    "image": "<base64-encoded image>",
    "prompt": "Make it a rainy night scene"
  }' --output result.png
```
